deductions.multiple_people: OR mismatch per active key, charged once per cut; retain all person reasons
deductions.action: independent whole-action mismatch evidence required; limb mismatch alone never adds action loss
deductions.torso: clear posture/bend/layout error only; camera azimuth alone is not mismatch
deductions.head: clear head/neck look direction difference; small tilt/eyes-only difference excluded

statuses.match: 관찰 가능하고 일치로 판정됨. 감점 없음.
statuses.mismatch: 판정 가능한 명확한 오류. 해당 배점 전액 차감.
statuses.uncertain: 관찰 자료는 있으나 확정 판정 보류. 0 또는 전액 감점 가능성을 범위에 반영.
statuses.unobservable: 가림/크롭 등으로 비교 불가. 활성 항목이면 해당 컷 범위 집계 제외.
statuses.not_run: 해당 항목 미판정/미실행. 활성 항목이면 해당 컷 범위 집계 제외.
statuses.not_applicable: 상반신 범위에서 양다리·전체 동작만 비활성. 일치가 아니며 배점 재분배 없음.

interval_rule.confirmed_loss_D: sum(weight[key] for any person mismatch, once per active key)
interval_rule.uncertain_loss_U: sum(weight[key] for any person uncertain AND no person mismatch on that key)
interval_rule.unknown_and_mismatch_same_key: confirmed mismatch takes precedence for cut loss; person-level uncertain remains recorded
interval_rule.eligible: returned_all AND every expected person mapped AND all active judgments match/mismatch/uncertain AND no core artifact missing
interval_rule.strict_definitive_E: eligible cases with every active judgment match/mismatch
interval_rule.confirmed_perfect: eligible AND every person active key match; low=high=score_max; no unresolved active judgment

partial_people_rule: Only if all returned persons active keys are definitive: min(score_max-D,50). Diagnostic only, excluded from scoped averages. Otherwise score null.

normal_no_result.requires: completed successful run with no returned people, evidenced by source receipt

threshold.description: 90점은 설정값이며 공식 확정 합격선이 아님. 상반신45에 자동 환산하지 않음.

metric_rules.P_over_E: confirmed/possible full_body threshold counts / full_body E

selection.policy: preserve original frozen best-of-returned-Top5 choice plus allowed refine
